title: Fundamental Structure (I. Static Aspect, II. Dynamic Aspect)

provenance.notes: Key text for the reflexivity intrinsic-or-constructed question. Nanavira argues for structural reflexivity without hidden substance — a middle path between Abhinavagupta's intrinsic self-manifestation and Dharmakīrti's conditioned cognition.

key_claims: Two things define a thing, namely the difference between them
Duration and Invariance under Transformation are one and the same
The structure of structure has the structure of structure
Past and future exist in the present as past and as future
A thing is eternal (endures forever at its own level)
The system is not reversible: future is future and past is past
